name: Invoice Exception Review
description: Compare invoice and purchase order totals and flag discrepancies for review.
request: Extracted invoice fields and a purchase order reference.
response: Matched fields, mismatches, and a review decision.

integration.operation: Review extracted invoice fields against an authorized purchase order.
integration.readiness: The public sandbox uses synthetic totals. A separately authenticated connector accepts caller-provided totals after deployment and configuration.

scenarios.label: Invoice total differs from purchase order
